title: What Scripture Actually Means When It Says Seek God First, Not a Wife
caption:
Seek first isn't a strategy for finding her. It's the only way to become the man she'd actually want to find.

Matthew 6:33 isn't a hack for getting a wife faster. It's an order of loves. Stop auditioning for a room and start building a life. Loneliness isn't evidence you're behind, it just means you're comparing God's timeline to Instagram's.

Become the man first. Meet her second. The order was never an accident.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #singleness #purpose
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
